notes: Bishop Chadwick's text in four stanzas (1-2 under the music, 3-4 printed below, p. 180); the refrain 'Gloria in excelsis Deo', sung twice to the music, is given once with the melisma hyphens removed. Stanza 4 is the Marian stanza ('Mary, Joseph, lend your aid') found in Catholic hymnals.
